title: Task starfleet/task-model-proxy-meta-models abgeschlossen
subtitle: Model-Proxy Meta-Models system implemented
body:
Model-Proxy Meta-Models system implemented and deployed:

- Config: Added strategies, routing, triggers, heuristics to model-proxy.yaml
- ModelProxyConfig: Extended with Strategies, Routing, ModelProxyStrategy, triggers, heuristics
- Proxy: StrategyState with circuit breaker, session affinity, metrics
- Routing: fallback, round-robin, weighted (sticky), single
- Circuit Breaker: closed/open/half-open with auto-recovery
- Heuristics: latency p95, error rate, token throughput, consecutive failures
- Session Affinity: sessionID -> model mapping
- API Endpoints:
  - GET /api/meta-models — list strategies
  - GET /api/meta-models/<strategy> — strategy details + runtime state
  - GET /api/meta-models/sessions — session affinities
  - POST /api/meta-models/switch — manual model switch per session
  - POST /api/meta-models/force — force model for all sessions
- CLI: starfleetctl model-proxy meta-models list|show|sessions|switch|force
- X-Context-Limit header set on chat responses (effective limit = min(context_window))
- Effective limits computed: heavy-model=200k, cruiser-model=262k, scout-model=262k, balanced-model=200k
- Tests pass, make all + starfleet-bootstrap + web/timer restart verified
